Hi all — I'm fairly new to Lean and have been working on formalizing the count of Invertible Matrices (order of a General Linear Group) over a finite field Z/pZ. I've got a first version here: https://tinyurl.com/3h8dwabw

Any feedback will be really appreciated, especially on whether the proof is presented nicely or anything that could be done more cleanly. Happy to hear about any reviews. Thanks!
Nice! One suggestion I would make is changing ∏ i : Fin n to ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, which allows the expression stay within the friendly type ℕ
This also allows the base case of the induction to collapes to | zero => simp
Thanks a lot! It does make sense that type N is a lot easier to deal with. I will have a try at that!
